conditions.network: IPv4 loopback HTTP/1.1 keep-alive, no inference TLS, same two-hop v1 fixture
conditions.authority: in-memory published route and credential slot; authenticated native relay; owned PostgreSQL/Valkey stopped
conditions.processes: B and C are separately prebuilt, long-lived Go test processes; compilation/setup and per-subrun checked warmup excluded
conditions.slow_reader: 100us requested sleep after every content event; actual OS timer may be coarser
conditions.resources: whole-process local client/provider/gateway or relay/instrumentation, not isolated gateway RSS
conditions.timing: 64 requests/subrun, two subruns/arm/block, 32 complete blocks/group; no omissions or selected retries
conditions.semantics: frozen v1 provider-bound request, complete response/SSE event oracle, exact asset, authentication and zero-dispatch rejection
